metadata.name: SONOZZ
metadata.description: Self-hosted music studio platform featuring artist discovery, album organization from A to Z, and comprehensive music library management. Requires Turso database for data storage and Google Gemini API key for AI-powered features (configured in-app after login).
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: TURSO_DATABASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Turso database URL (required) - Create at https://turso.tech

environment_variables.name: TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Turso authentication token (required) - Get from Turso dashboard

environment_variables.name: AUTH_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Admin login password - Change this from default 'changeme'

environment_variables.name: AUTH_SECRET
environment_variables.description: Authentication secret key - Use a long random string

environment_variables.name: AUTH_SECURE
environment_variables.description: Secure cookies (0=disabled for HTTP on LAN, 1=enabled for HTTPS)

before_install: SONOZZ requires a Turso database - Create one at https://turso.tech before installation
Set TURSO_DATABASE_URL and TURSO_AUTH_TOKEN from your Turso dashboard
Change default AUTH_PASSWORD and AUTH_SECRET for security
Use AUTH_SECURE=0 for HTTP access on local network (CasaOS default)
Google Gemini API key can be configured in-app after first login
Default login: admin@example.com / changeme (change AUTH_EMAIL and AUTH_PASSWORD)
